Remark
[Calabi--Yau linear volume growth]

Source: petersen:page-0322 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-structure-theorem 1. ch7:7.5.2Let $(M,g)$ be complete noncompact with $\Ric \ge 0$, $p\in M$.

  1. Show that for each $R>1$ there is $x\in M$ with

    \[ \vol B(p,1)\le \vol B(x,R+1)-\vol B(x,R-1) \le \frac{(R+1)^n-(R-1)^n}{(R+1)^n}\vol B(p,2R). \]

  2. Show there is $C>0$ with $\vol B(p,R)\ge CR$.
